intro.title: Introduction
intro.story: Good morning. Let's begin your shift.
intro.chart:
DiseaseSymptoms
PneumoniaCoughing, Fever, Chills, Shortness of breath
StrokeWeakness in one arm, Slurred speech
Heart AttackChest pain, Shortness of breath
Anxiety AttackRapid heart rate, Sweating, Trembling

patient1.title: Patient 1
patient1.story: John has a fever with coughing and shortness of breath. What is your diagnosis?

patient1Correct.title: Correct
patient1Correct.story: Symptoms of pneumonia include coughing, fever, chills, shortness of breath. What would you like to do next?

patient1Wrong.title: Incorrect
patient1Wrong.story: John does not exhibit symptoms of a stroke.

patient2.title: Patient 2
patient2.story: Jane has weakness in one of her arms and is slurring her words. What is your diagnosis?

patient2Correct.title: Correct
patient2Correct.story: Jane exhibits symptoms of a stroke. What would you like to do next?

patient2Wrong.title: Incorrect
patient2Wrong.story: Jane's symptoms do not suggest an allergic reaction.

patient3.title: Patient 3
patient3.story: Robert complains of chest pain and shortness of breath. Calculate the correct dose based on weight 80kg. Each kg requires 0.5 units.

actionItems.hint: Remember to calculate the dose by multiplying the weight (80kg) by the dosage per kg (0.5 units).

startBreak.title: Break #1
startBreak.story: You're back in the breakroom. You have two options: 1) Enjoy yourself      2) Work on telemedicine until your next rotation

breakRoom.title: Breakroom
breakRoom.story: You've finished available telemedicine visits. Sit tight and enjoy yourself until your break is over!

breakEnd.title: Break Over
breakEnd.story: Your break is over. Time to get back to work!

telemedicine1.title: Telemedicine Session 1
telemedicine1.story: Welcome to your first telemedicine session. Please log on to see your first patient.

telePatient1_1.title: Telemedicine Patient 1
telePatient1_1.story: Zoe has had a headache for over an hour as well as sensitivity to light. What is your diagnosis?

telePatient1_1Correct.title: Correct
telePatient1_1Correct.story: Zoe's symptoms are indicative of a migraine. Proceed to the next patient.

telePatient1_1Wrong.title: Incorrect
telePatient1_1Wrong.story: Zoe's symptoms do not suggest the flu.

telePatient1_2.title: Telemedicine Patient 2
telePatient1_2.story: Jaime has a fever, cough, sore throat, and stuffy nose. What is your diagnosis?

telePatient1_2Wrong.title: Incorrect
telePatient1_2Wrong.story: Jaime's symptoms are not indicative of a migraine.

patient4.title: Patient 4
patient4.story: Ishan complains of chest pain and shortness of breath. What is your diagnosis?

patient4Correct.title: Correct
patient4Correct.story: Ishan is experiencing symptoms of a heart attack. What would you like to do next?

patient4Wrong.title: Incorrect
patient4Wrong.story: Ishan's symptoms are indicative of a medical emergency.

startBreak2.title: Break #2
startBreak2.story: You're back in the breakroom. You have two options: 1) Enjoy yourself      2) Work on telemedicine until your next rotation

breakEnd2.title: Break Over
breakEnd2.story: Your break is over. Time to get back to work!

telemedicine2.title: Telemedicine Session 2
telemedicine2.story: Welcome to your second telemedicine session. Please log on to see your next patients.

telePatient2_1.title: Telemedicine Patient 2.1
telePatient2_1.story: Sam has been experiencing recurring headaches and sensitivity to light. What is your diagnosis?

telePatient2_1Correct.title: Correct
telePatient2_1Correct.story: Sam's symptoms are indicative of a migraine. Proceed to the next patient.

telePatient2_1Wrong.title: Incorrect
telePatient2_1Wrong.story: Sam's symptoms do not suggest the flu.

telePatient2_2.title: Telemedicine Patient 2.2
telePatient2_2.story: Linda has a fever, cough, sore throat, and a stuffy nose. What is your diagnosis?

telePatient2_2Wrong.title: Incorrect
telePatient2_2Wrong.story: Linda's symptoms are not indicative of a migraine.

patient5.title: Patient 5
patient5.story: Alex complains of sudden chest pain and difficulty breathing. What is your diagnosis?

patient5Correct.title: Correct
patient5Correct.story: Alex is experiencing symptoms of a heart attack. What would you like to do next?

patient5Wrong.title: Incorrect
patient5Wrong.story: Alex's symptoms are indicative of a medical emergency, but not an anxiety attack.
